evidence.text: Halden Bet is recorded as a Strategic Sportsbook account in GB, owned by Maya Lindgren, with a customer-since date of 2021-02-01.
Expired signed contract K-0001 covered the term from 2023-02-01 through 2025-01-31 and recorded €692,000 in ARR during that term.

Contract K-0002 ends on 2027-01-31. The recorded term is 24 months. The 60-day notice period puts the recorded deadline on 2026-12-02, 31 days after the snapshot. The recorded terms provide for auto-renewal.
caveats: Notice delivery and waivers are absent from the available records. The recorded rule does not establish renewal execution.

usage.yoy_rule: both full same-month windows observed; positive prior denominator for percentage
usage.yoy_rounding: percentage change to nearest 0.1 percentage point using half-up rounding

support.open_basis: opened by period end with no closure by period end; historical states are reconstructed from dates

raw.title: Renewal pre-discussion
raw.body:
# Renewal pre-discussion: Halden Bet

Date: 2026-10-07
Author: Maya Lindgren

Attendees: Halden head of trading, Halden procurement, Maya Lindgren.

- Head of trading mentioned they are trialling another in-play odds supplier "for two leagues" since the summer.
- Procurement wants pricing for a reduced in-play scope at renewal. Budget pressure from their finance team.
- Still positive about the live data feed and pre-match odds.

Actions: Maya to prepare renewal options before notice date.

# Quarterly review: Halden Bet plc

Date: 2025-11-20
Author: Maya Lindgren

Attendees: Halden head of trading, Halden CTO, Maya Lindgren (account owner).

- Good quarter overall. Trading team happy with in-play coverage and pre-match pricing.
- They raised the price increase at the last renewal again but accepted it "for now".
- Interest in more streaming for lower leagues next year, nothing concrete.

Actions: Maya to share roadmap for in-play latency improvements.
